text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Announcement! The souvenir this time is... 
Bande dessinée... French comic books!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged! France has its own distinct 
manga culture compared to Japan, does it 
not? I hear many of the works possess 
great artistic depth...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You place great value on broadening 
your horizons as well, don't you, Yayoi? 
By all means, refine your sensibilities 
while having fun!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! As I thought, I still lack 
"depth"...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To shoulder the responsibility of 
Chairwoman, mental growth is also 
essential! Thanks for looking out for me!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha, Yayoi really is admirable. ...Well, 
is it okay if I head out now?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"! C-Could that be... the exact same one I 
received back then...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ah, an assortment of French sweets! 
Though, maybe it's a bit too childish?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! My bad, my bad, just kidding! 
There's plenty, so snack on as much as you 
like.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...So make sure you grow with all your 
might! I'm counting on you, Chairwoman 
Akikawa!"
